description: Angular component for a dialog to add entities to a customer, supporting multiple entity types and performing batch assignments via services.

classes.name: AddEntitiesToCustomerDialogData
classes.description: Interface defining data passed to the dialog, including customer ID and entity type.

classes.name: AddEntitiesToCustomerDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a dialog that assigns multiple entities to a customer, supporting device, asset, edge, entity view, and dashboard types.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets dialog titles based on entity type.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state, considering custom validation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without making changes.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Performs batch assignment of selected entities to the customer.

methods.name: getAssignToCustomerTask
methods.description: Returns an observable for assigning a specific entity to a customer based on entity type.
